title: Hello Kitty, Farmhouse Edition
description: Hello Kitty in a farmhouse kitchen: the Apples and Pumpkins pajama set, a big plush Hello Kitty sweatshirt, slipper socks, the I Love Pink throw, a leopard camper mug and the Hello Kitty cake pop maker.
intro: Hello Kitty belongs in a farmhouse kitchen more than anyone gives her credit for. Apples and pumpkins on the pajamas, a sweatshirt with a 3D bow, fuzzy socks on the kitchen floor, coffee in a leopard camper mug, and a cake pop maker that turns out tiny Hello Kitty faces. Six finds for a slow fall Saturday.

sections.heading: The pajamas that started it
paragraphs: The Bioworld Apples and Pumpkins set is a light pink tee with Hello Kitty and a basket of apples and pumpkins, and coral pajama pants printed all over with Hello Kitty, apples and pumpkins. It is fall, it is pink, it is the whole point.

sections.heading: Layer the sweatshirt on top
paragraphs: Pink, oversized fleece, with a big plush Hello Kitty appliqué in blue overalls and a red 3D bow. Pull it over the pajama tee on a cold morning and you are dressed for the kitchen, the porch and the school run.

sections.heading: The kitchen pieces
paragraphs: The Uncanny Brands cake pop maker is pastel pink with Hello Kitty on the lid and makes four Hello Kitty cake pops at a time. The Silver Buffalo camper mug holds 20 ounces and has Hello Kitty in a leopard outfit and bow.
The Northwest Silk Touch throw is 50 by 70 inches in bright pink with Hello Kitty, bows and hearts. The slipper socks are grey and fuzzy with sherpa cuffs, Hello Kitty faces and pink dots.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the pajama set, the sweatshirt, the slipper socks, the throw, the mug and the cake pop maker. The bedspread, kitchen, island, stools, apples, pumpkins, flowers, kettle, gingham towel, cake pops and the dog are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
